title: Lookup segments
intro: A segment is a VLAN and its IP range. When a check-in can't be answered from the tables, Floorbit asks the switches for that one PC, but only in segments with lookups on. Every segment starts with lookups off.
noneOn: Lookups are off in every segment, so check-ins only use LibreNMS and the tables. Turn them on for the seat segments.
emptyDesc: Take them from discovery (VLAN interfaces with an address on the core) or add them by hand.
name: Name
addDesc: For a VLAN discovery can't see, e.g. one routed by a firewall.
